chunks: Muhammad ibn Ibrahim ibn Ishaq al-Talqani (may God be pleased with him) narrated to us, saying: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Sa'id al-Hamadani, a client of the Banu Hashim, narrated to us, saying: Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Fadhal narrated to us from his father, saying: I heard Abu al-Hasan Ali ibn Musa al-Rida (peace be upon him) say:

I will be killed and poisoned and buried in a land of exile. I know this by a covenant that my father conveyed to me from his father, from his forefathers, from the Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family). So, whoever visits me in my exile, I and my forefathers will be his intercessors on the Day of Resurrection. And whoever we intercede for is saved, even if he has the burden of the sins of the Jinn and mankind.

key_terms.وِزْرِ الثَّقَلَيْنِ: burden of the two heavy ones (Jinn and mankind)

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for visiting Imam al-Rida in his exile according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from Shaykh al-Saduq’s *‘Uyun Akhbar al-Rida* highlights the theological significance of Imam al-Rida’s martyrdom and burial in Tus (Khurasan), framing his 'exile' as a locus of divine mercy. It establishes a unique Shia doctrine of intercession (*shafa'ah*), promising that visiting his shrine secures salvation from the Ahl al-Bayt even for those burdened with significant sins, emphasizing the spiritual efficacy of *ziyarat*.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 66-33 Muhammad ibn Ibrahim ibn Ishaq al-Taleqani - may God be pleased with him -narrated that Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Sa’eed al-Hamadani - a chief of the Hashemite tribe narrated that Ali ibn Al-Hassan ibn Fadhdhal quoted on the authority of his father that he had heard (the 8th Imam) Abal Hassan Ali ibn Musa Ar-Ridha’ (a.s.) say,

“I will be killed by being poisoned and I will be buried in a strange land.This has been promised to me by my father, from his father, from his father, from his forefathers, from Ali ibn Abi Talib (a.s.), and from God’s Prophet (S). Indeed, if anyone visits me in my loneliness, then my forefathers and I will intercede on his behalf on the Resurrection Day. Whoever we intercede for is saved, even if he has the burden of the sins of the jinn and the people.”
